_about: Crafting proficiency EXP per successful craft, measured in-game. Failure = 30% of it, a Combo success = 130%. Keyed by product name and yield; applies to both factions. No public source lists EXP for every recipe (searched 2026-10-19), so everything not listed here is estimated in build_data.py.
